name: ice-orca-dragon-control-plane
description: Effect-powered control plane for the ICE_ORCA_DRAGON numerical workbench

scripts.graph:review: tsx src/cli.ts ontology review --graph all --base HEAD
scripts.graph:export: tsx src/cli.ts ontology export --format jsonld --graph all
scripts.graph:interop-check: npm run typecheck && vitest run test/ontology-rdf.test.ts test/ontology-shacl.test.ts test/ontology-sparql.test.ts test/ontology-crate.test.ts && npm run ice -- ontology shacl --graph all
scripts.graph:check: npm run check && npm run ice -- ontology validate && npm run ice -- ontology shacl --graph all && npm run ice -- graphrag eval --limit 12 --json && npm run ice -- ontology competency --json && npm run agent:eval
scripts.graph:release-check: npm run graph:check && npm run ice -- ontology coverage --json && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
